title: Gemstones language-model training trajectories
question: How do architecture and compute allocation affect training-loss trajectories?
publisher: Gemstones authors, University of Maryland research team; training at Oak Ridge National Laboratory Frontier
measurement_dates: 2025 research release; immutable Git commit 5f420478f6057b0cbb4d13405fb10ca64675bccb. Trajectory execution dates are source fields where present.
variables_and_units: Variables and units are preserved in native column headers, instrument metadata and source dictionaries; see evidence anchors below.
independent_units: Training run, model architecture and held-out compute ranges.
validation_design: Training run, model architecture and held-out compute ranges. Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Authors extracted, grouped and filtered W&B logs before publication. Their live W&B space is private; the public JSONLs are the provided intermediate release. Model weights, corpora and additional validation collections are not downloaded.
prior_analysis_and_limits: Gemstones, arXiv:2502.06857 / NeurIPS 2025, already fits scaling laws. Source filtering can exclude failed/divergent runs; this collection cannot restore them. Chunks/steps are not independent models. Gemstones pinned computational training JSONLs and extraction code. Published scaling laws are disclosed; trajectories within a run are dependent.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.

eligibility.novelty: no unseen-law guarantee; independent adjudication required

exposure: Open source-aware; source literature and supplied analyses accessible
unit_interpretation: Use exact source field/sheet/channel labels and units in source_evidence and per-file reports; unknown units remain unresolved, not inferred from a variable name.
